reason: Not refuted. The table is needed plan hygiene and is feasible, but it is NOT yet mechanical as the action claims. FEASIBILITY: the times work. W4 K2 slots 00:05/00:45/01:25Z plus L 7.4-7.8 h finish by ~09:15Z; CI 00:06/00:46Z plus 9.7-10.5 h finish by ~11:20Z; both land before the 29 Sep 12:00Z card. 4 planned files plus 1 E10 fits the 5/day limit, and nothing goes after 02:00Z. Hidden runs show no parallel slowdown (exp70j/k submitted in the same minute: 7.74 h; exp70a/d/e, 3 concurrent: 7.04-7.42 h), so the +24% dummy effect does not transfer. Every file on the list either exists (exp79a/81/82a-c/83a/b/f/84a/85a/86a-c) or is a CPU-only build (exp87a-j, R24S-4, not yet built at 07:05Z). S6 (no DIV-only file after 01:45Z) holds, since exp84a is at 01:25Z. VALUE: this is logistics only; it gains no score by itself. The READMIT/ILP arms are disclosed 743929 knobs, actionable under aggressive mode, and not a closed line. Caveat: the plan selects on many 3-decimal public reads of one embryo, so a W4 '+' enters the finals pool only as a public read. DEFECTS: (1) R? with Cx matches NO row: (c) covers R+ and (f) covers R0/R- only. This cell is plausible. 50 reads 0.956 after 47 or 49 showed an UP or 0.957 -> '?' per v3 (1), while Cx (0/-/NO-OP/v/ERROR) is the modal CI outcome. (2) 50 = ERROR, 'v', or not terminal by 23:30Z is unmapped. (3) (c)'s 'SEC(b) only if exp81 read +' can never fire: under R+, W2b Row 3 takes exp86c/exp86a, never exp81, and W2a went to exp85a. (4) (e) lacks (d)'s clause 'JT(b) if R? and b != exp70g'. (5) Two stop rules contradict W4 AMEND 2 (1)-1 (FULL = BASE + every '+' lever): 'exp86c > exp85a -> JT files keep 0.94, no 0.92+CI' and 'no RA98+CI build'. Under C+ they deliberately leave out the best-read stack, and that needs to be stated as an amendment, not left implicit. (6) The dummy deadline of 23:30Z is stricter than AMEND 2's 00:00Z, which is fine but should be written as superseding it. None of these defects invalidates the table; each is a one-line fix before the first W1 read (~07:30Z).
